import pandas as pd

def transform_source_to_target(source_path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Load the source CSV, extract the V_GENE from V_CALL column by removing the allele part,
    and return a DataFrame with the target schema ['V_GENE'].
    """
    # Load source data
    df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path)
    
    # Extract V_GENE by splitting on '*' and taking the first part
    df_source['V_GENE'] = df_source['V_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    
    # Select only the target column
    df_target = df_source[['V_GENE']].copy()
    
    return df_target

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]
    
    # Process each source and collect results
    target_dfs = []
    for source_path in source_files:
        df_transformed = transform_source_to_target(source_path)
        target_dfs.append(df_transformed)
    
    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (union all)
    df_final = pd.concat(target_dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Optional: If you want unique V_GENE values only (not specified, but often desired)
    # df_final = df_final.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Write the final target dataframe to CSV
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
